gates.description: Self-service interface must be provided for platform capabilities (CLI, portal, or API)
Golden path from code to production must be documented
Platform SLOs must be defined (CI/CD availability, deployment time, provisioning time)
Platform documentation must exist: quick-start, reference, and troubleshooting
Guardrails must prevent misuse (resource limits, policy checks)
Cost allocation per team must be tracked

anti_patterns.description: Building platform features nobody asked for — engineering a perfect abstraction while developers struggle with basic needs
Every developer request requires a ticket and a platform engineer to fulfill it — the platform is just a team with a queue
Creating abstractions before understanding what developers actually need — the abstraction doesn't match reality
Every team has their own custom setup — the platform team supports 15 different CI/CD configurations
The platform team becomes the gate for everything — no team can ship without platform approval

escalation_triggers: Platform SLO violated (CI/CD down, deployments failing, provisioning broken)
Security vulnerability in a platform component affecting all tenants
Developer adoption stalled — teams building around the platform instead of using it
Cost runaway — platform costs growing faster than usage
Breaking change required that affects all teams simultaneously
Capacity limits — platform can't handle the number of teams or services

input_requirements.description: Spec.md with platform requirements and developer pain points

output_certifications: Golden path from code to production documented
Self-service interface provided for all common operations
